senses.gloss: f. (רָדָה II) detaching, taking bread out of the oven.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 29b:9">R. Hash. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>רְדִיַּית הפת וכ׳</he> the taking out of the bread, which is an art but no labor.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:19">Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>היו בקיאין … וברְדִיָּיתוֹ</he> they were skilled in making the show-bread and in taking it out; Y. Yoma III, 41ᵃ; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite>; a. e.
